observations.behavior: Adds a helper function `findAnchorStart` and its use in `addUtmTagsToEmail` to replace a case-insensitive `indexOf` on a lowercased string with a case-sensitive regex search on the original string, while also adding a `fixedScanner` parameter to optionally retain legacy behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: This change improves the efficiency and robustness of the UTM tag injection worker in PostHog's CDP (Customer Data Platform) email processing. The previous implementation lowercased the entire HTML body before searching, which could stall workers on large, unclosed, or malformed HTML.
